### Development and CI/CD

- (ci) [Make the node-build job faster, deterministic first](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3326) by [@fiunchinho](https://github.com/fiunchinho) — CircleCI's node-build job runs the unit tests alone with more workers and without coverage, then the type check and lint side by side, cutting the job from about 14 to about 11 minutes.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.28.0...v3.28.1
